crop.notes: Whole article, headline to end, with portraits of Ed Kelly and Dan Daly.

ocr.notes: Most of the narrative is readable, but the text around the two portraits and rounds 26-37 are badly garbled.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Dan Daly beat Ed Kelly, son of Tom Kelly, in a brutal 62-round glove fight at Hurricane, Missouri, the longest on record. Tom Allen and Tom Kelly seconded young Kelly.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, April 27, 1887', page 8. The fight was 'yesterday', April 26.

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly seconded Ed Kelly in his 62-round fight with Dan Daly under Queensberry rules for a $500 stake; Daly was given the fight after about four hours
places: Hurricane, Missouri (near Richfield, on the Chicago, Burlington and Quincy line)

notes: Allen is mentioned only once, as Ed Kelly's second; the article is about the Daly-Kelly fight. The deck says four hours seven minutes, while the text gives 12:25 to 4:20 p.m.
